<select id="selectInstallationSelectionPage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT * FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId} AND deleted=FALSE
      AND object_key='INSTALLATION_HISTORY' AND source_object='pm_project_shipment'
    <choose><when test="query.deviceSns != null and !query.deviceSns.isEmpty()">
      AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fields_json,'$.originalFields.barcode')) IN
      <foreach collection="query.deviceSns" item="sn" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{sn}</foreach>
    </when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    <if test="query.afterId != null">AND id > #{query.afterId}</if>
    ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
  </select>

<select id="selectRetiredSourceKeysForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT * FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId}
      AND object_key=#{query.object} AND source_object=#{query.sourceObject} AND deleted=TRUE
    <choose><when test="query.sourceKeys != null and !query.sourceKeys.isEmpty()">
      AND source_key IN <foreach collection="query.sourceKeys" item="key" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{key}</foreach>
    </when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
  </select>

<select id="selectIdentitySources" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b
    JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE
    WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE
      AND t.source_system=#{query.sourceSystem} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId}
      AND (t.adapter=#{query.adapter}
        <if test="query.originalOnly and query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION' AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info') AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')</if>
        <if test="!query.originalOnly">
        <choose>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP_DIRECT' AND b.object_key='DEVICE_BASE' AND b.source_object='ast_device_shipment')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('pm_project_header','pm_project_identity'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ORGANIZATION'">
            OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ORGANIZATION_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('COMPANY','DEPARTMENT','fnd_department','ehr_department','COMPANY_REFERENCE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USERS'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info')
                AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_ROLE','FND_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_ROLES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_USER_ROLE','FND_USER_ROLE'))
          </when>
          <when test="query.adapter == 'DPPMS_USER_SCOPES'">
            OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user_info','fnd_user_info','fnd_user_power')
                AND b.source_key LIKE '%:%')
          </when>
        </choose>
        </if>
      ) AND b.source_object=#{query.sourceObject}
    <choose>
      <when test="query.sourceKeys != null and !query.sourceKeys.isEmpty()">
        AND b.source_key IN
        <foreach collection="query.sourceKeys" item="key" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{key}</foreach>
      </when>
      <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
    </choose>
    ORDER BY b.id
  </select>

<select id="selectEhrEmployeeUsers" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b
    JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE
    WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND t.source_system='DPPMS'
      AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT')
      <if test="query.originalOnly">AND t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION'</if>
      AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','fnd_user_info') AND b.object_key=b.source_object
      AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%'
    <choose><when test="query.sourceEmployeeIds != null and !query.sourceEmployeeIds.isEmpty()">
      AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.fields_json,'$._verifiedEhrEmployeeId')) IN
      <foreach collection="query.sourceEmployeeIds" item="employee" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{employee}</foreach>
    </when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    ORDER BY b.id
  </select>

<select id="selectFirstTaskBindingId" resultType="java.lang.Long">
    SELECT id FROM int_sync_binding
    WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted=FALSE
    LIMIT 1
  </select>

<select id="selectObsoleteOrderLinesForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncBindingDO">
    SELECT * FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId}
      AND object_key='LINE' AND source_object='pm_order_line_from_erp' AND deleted=FALSE
      AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fields_json,'$.companyCode')) AS BINARY)=CAST('01' AS BINARY)
    <choose><when test="query.sourceKeys != null and !query.sourceKeys.isEmpty()">
      AND source_key IN <foreach collection="query.sourceKeys" item="key" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{key}</foreach>
    </when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
  </select>

<select id="selectMaintenance" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.dal.dataobject.sync.SyncRunDO">
    SELECT id, status, config_snapshot FROM int_sync_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE
      AND (cache_pending=TRUE OR (status IN ('QUEUED','READING','VALIDATING','APPLYING') AND started_at < #{now}))
      ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
  </select>
<select id="selectCatalogue" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.api.migration.SystemDepartmentMigrationApi$Department"><include refid="catalogue" /></select>
<select id="selectCatalogueForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.api.migration.SystemDepartmentMigrationApi$Department"><include refid="catalogue" /> FOR UPDATE</select>

<select id="selectLeaderUserIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">
        SELECT id FROM system_users WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE
        <choose><when test="query.userIds != null and !query.userIds.isEmpty()">
            AND id IN <foreach collection="query.userIds" item="id" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{id}</foreach>
        </when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose>
    </select>

<update id="completeHistoricalLeader">
        UPDATE system_dept SET leader_user_id=#{after.leaderUserId},version=#{after.version},
            updater=#{after.updater},update_time=#{after.updateTime}
        WHERE id=#{before.id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE
            AND version=#{before.version} AND leader_user_id IS NULL
    </update>

<insert id="insertHistoricalDepartment">
        INSERT INTO system_dept(id,code,name,parent_id,sort,leader_user_id,phone,email,status,version,
            creator,create_time,updater,update_time,deleted,tenant_id)
        VALUES(#{department.id},#{department.code},#{department.name},#{department.parentId},#{department.sort},
            #{department.leaderUserId},#{department.phone},#{department.email},#{department.status},#{department.version},
            #{department.creator},#{department.createTime},#{department.updater},#{department.updateTime},FALSE,#{tenantId})
    </insert>

    SELECT * FROM system_company WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

<select id="selectAllDepartmentsForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.dal.dataobject.dept.DeptDO">

<select id="selectDepartmentsForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.dal.dataobject.dept.DeptDO">
    SELECT * FROM system_dept WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
  </select>

<select id="selectCompanyForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.dal.dataobject.company.CompanyDO">
    SELECT * FROM system_company WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
  </select>

<select id="selectDepartmentForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.dal.dataobject.dept.DeptDO">
    SELECT * FROM system_dept WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
  </select>

<select id="countClearReferences" resultType="long">
    SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users u JOIN system_dept d ON d.id=u.dept_id AND d.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
       WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=FALSE)
      + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_user_company_department_scope s
         WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.deleted=FALSE AND
           (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM system_company c WHERE c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.id=s.company_id)
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM system_dept d WHERE d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.id=s.department_id)))
      + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_role r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.deleted=FALSE
         AND r.data_scope=2 AND r.data_scope_dept_ids IS NOT NULL AND r.data_scope_dept_ids NOT IN ('','[]'))
  </select>
<delete id="deleteCompanies">DELETE FROM system_company WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}</delete>
<delete id="deleteDepartments">DELETE FROM system_dept WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}</delete>

<select id="selectForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.dal.dataobject.organization.OrganizationOwnershipDO">
    SELECT * FROM system_organization_ownership
    WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND object_type=#{objectType} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
  </select>
<select id="selectProfiles" resultMap="migrationUser"><include refid="profiles" /></select>
<select id="selectProfilesForUpdate" resultMap="migrationUser"><include refid="profiles" /> FOR UPDATE</select>

<select id="selectDepartmentIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">
        SELECT id FROM system_dept <include refid="references" />
    </select>

<select id="selectPostIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">
        SELECT id FROM system_post <include refid="references" />
    </select>

<select id="selectHistoricalMemberIdentities" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.api.migration.SystemUserMigrationApi$MemberIdentity">
        SELECT id,username,employee_no FROM system_users WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE
        <choose>
            <when test="query.usernames != null and !query.usernames.isEmpty()">
                AND username IN <foreach collection="query.usernames" item="username" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{username}</foreach>
            </when>
            <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
        </choose>
        ORDER BY id
    </select>

<select id="selectHistoricalIdentities" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.api.migration.SystemUserMigrationApi$HistoricalIdentity">
        SELECT id,username FROM system_users <include refid="references" /> ORDER BY id
    </select>

<select id="selectHistoricalIdentitiesByUsername" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.system.api.migration.SystemUserMigrationApi$HistoricalIdentity">
        SELECT id,username FROM system_users WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE
        <choose>
            <when test="query.usernames != null and !query.usernames.isEmpty()">
                AND username IN <foreach collection="query.usernames" item="username" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{username}</foreach>
            </when>
            <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
        </choose>
        ORDER BY id
    </select>
